Name: Murrthecat's Quails for 1.6
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
With permission from Murrthecat, I have converted their BFAV Quails (found at https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4847) to ContentPatcher to work on SDV 1.6. Credit to Murrthecat for the original mod.

Quails live in coops and produce quail eggs. Large quail eggs can be turned into quail mayonnaise. There are also a couple quail egg recipes

NOTE: ONLY THE LARGE EGGS MAKE THE MAYO. The regular ones do not, it's not a bug. Quail eggs are itty-bitty so only the large ones make the mayo for realism's sake

Enjoy!
